### 182. Section

Unlawful Consumption of Electricity, Thermal Energy and Gas, Unlawful Use of Electronic Communications Services

(1)	For unlawful consumption of electricity, thermal energy or gas or for unlawful use of electronic communications services, if committed in a substantial amount, —

shall be punished by short-term deprivation of liberty or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For unlawful consumption of electricity, thermal energy or gas or for unlawful use of electronic communications services, if committed in a large amount, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to two years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(As worded by the Law of 21.06.2007. with amendments made by the Laws of 13.12.2012., 29.10.2015. and 17.12.2020., which comes into force on 01.01.2022.)

Section 182.1 Unlawful Actions with Commercial Metering of Consumed Electricity, Thermal Energy and Gas

(1)	For interference with the operation of commercial metering devices for electricity, thermal energy or gas or for disruption thereof, or for the manufacture, adaptation, distribution or installation of equipment, devices or software, if it creates the possibility for persons to unlawfully consume electricity, thermal energy or gas, —

shall be punished by short-term deprivation of liberty or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the same actions, if committed by a group of persons pursuant to prior agreement or if they have caused serious consequences, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(3)	For the actions provided for in paragraph one of this Section, if they have caused the death of two or more persons, — shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to eight years.
(As worded by the Law of 21.10.2010. with amendments made by the Laws of 13.12.2012., 25.09.2014. and 17.12.2020., which comes into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 183. Section Extortion

(1)	For a demand without legal basis to surrender property or rights to property or to perform any actions of a proprietary nature, threatening violence against the victim or his or her relatives, threatening to disclose disgraceful information about the victim or his or her relatives, threatening to destroy their property or to cause them other substantial harm (extortion), —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property.

(2)	For extortion, if committed by a group of persons pursuant to prior agreement or if committed using violence, weapons or explosives, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to ten years, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property, and with probation supervision for a term of up to three years.
(With amendments made by the Laws of 08.07.2011., 13.12.2012. and 17.12.2020., which comes into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 184. Section Extortion in an Organised Group

(1)	For the creation of an organised group or participation therein for the purpose of extortion —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to eight years, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property and with probation supervision for a term of up to three years.

(2)	For extortion as part of an organised group, if the extortion was committed using violence or threats, weapons or explosives, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term from three to twelve years, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property, and with probation supervision for a term of up to three years.

(3)	For the actions provided for in paragraph two of this Section, if they have caused serious consequences, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term from five to fifteen years, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property, and with probation supervision for a term of up to three years.
(With amendments made by the Laws of 08.07.2011. and 13.12.2012., which comes into force on 01.04.2013. See transitional provision paragraph 11)

### 185. Section Intentional Destruction and Damage of Property

(1)	For intentional destruction or damage of another's property —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to two years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For intentional destruction or damage of another's property, if committed by burning or in another generally dangerous manner

or if committed in a large amount, or if as a result thereof the death of a person has occurred through the negligence of the guilty person or other serious consequences have been caused, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to ten years and with probation supervision for a term of up to three years or without it.
(With amendments made by the Laws of 12.02.2004., 13.12.2012., 29.10.2015. and 17.12.2020., which comes into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 186. Section Destruction and Damage of Property through Negligence

(1)	For destruction or damage of another's property through negligence, by careless handling of fire or in another generally dangerous manner and if as a result thereof substantial harm has been caused, —

shall be punished by short-term deprivation of liberty or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For destruction or damage of another's property through negligence, if as a result thereof the death of a person has occurred or other serious consequences have been caused, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(3)	For destruction or damage of another's property through negligence, if as a result thereof the death of two or more persons has occurred, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(With amendments made by the Laws of 12.02.2004., 13.12.2012., 25.09.2014., 11.06.2020. and 17.12.2020., which
comes into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 187. Section

Intentional Destruction and Damage of Electrical Network, Public Electronic Communications Network, Heating Network, Gas, Oil and Oil Product Pipeline

(1)	For intentional destruction or damage of an electrical network, public electronic communications network, heating network, gas, oil or oil product pipeline or its installations —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the same actions, if as a result thereof the death of a person has occurred or if they have caused an accident, disaster or other serious consequences, or if committed by an organised group, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term from two to ten years, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property, and with probation supervision for a term of up to three years or without it.
(With amendments made by the Laws of 13.12.2007., 21.10.2010., 08.07.2011., 13.12.2012. and 17.12.2020., which
comes into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 188. Section Destruction and Damage of Gas and Oil Pipelines through Negligence

(1)	For destruction or damage of gas, oil or oil product pipelines and their installations through negligence — shall be punished by short-term deprivation of liberty or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(2)	For the same actions, if as a result thereof the death of a person has occurred or if they have caused an accident, disaster or other serious consequences, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(3)	For the actions provided for in paragraph one of this Section, if as a result thereof the death of two or more persons has occurred, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to eight years.
(With amendments made by the Laws of 12.02.2004., 21.10.2010., 13.12.2012., 25.09.2014. and 17.12.2020., which
comes into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 189. Section Unconscientious and Careless Guarding of Property

### 190. Section. Smuggling

(1)	For the import into the customs territory of the Republic of Latvia or export from it of goods subject to customs duties or other valuables, bypassing customs control or concealing them from such control, or by failing to declare them, or by using forged customs or other documents, or in any other unlawful manner (smuggling), if it has been committed on a considerable scale, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to one year, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property.

(2)	For the criminal offence provided for in paragraph one of this Section, if it has been committed by a group of persons pursuant to prior agreement, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to four years, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property.

(3)	For the criminal offence provided for in paragraph one of this Section, if it has been committed by an organised group, or for smuggling, if it has been committed on a large scale, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to ten years, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property, and with probation supervision for a term of up to three years or without it, with deprivation of the right to engage in specific or all types of commercial activity or in a specific occupation or the right to hold a specific position for a term of up to five years.

(4)	(Deleted by the Law of 13.12.2012.)
(In the wording of the Law of 28.04.2005. with amendments made by the Laws of 13.12.2007., 13.12.2012., 29.10.2015., 08.06.2017.,
03.09.2020. and 17.12.2020., which comes into force on 01.01.2022.)

190.	1 Section. Movement of goods and substances, the circulation of which is prohibited or specially regulated, across the state border of the Republic of Latvia

(1)	For the movement across the state border of the Republic of Latvia in any unlawful manner of a narcotic or psychotropic substance, raw materials (precursors) intended for the manufacture of such substances, a new psychoactive substance or a product containing it, the circulation of which is prohibited or restricted, as well as of a radioactive or hazardous substance, goods of strategic importance or other valuables, explosives, weapons, ammunition —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property.

(2)	For the same acts, if they have been committed by a group of persons pursuant to prior agreement or if they have been committed on a large scale, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to ten years, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property.

(3)	For the same acts, if they have been committed by an organised group, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to twelve years, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property, and with probation supervision for a term of up to three years, with deprivation of the right to engage in specific or all types of commercial activity or in a

specific occupation or the right to hold a specific position for a term of up to five years.
(In the wording of the Law of 28.04.2005. with amendments made by the Laws of 21.06.2007., 13.12.2007., 19.11.2009., 08.07.2011.,
13.12.2012., 25.09.2014. and 17.12.2020., which comes into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 191. Section. Unauthorised acts with goods subject to customs duties and other valuables

(1)	For the storage, movement, forwarding or sale in the customs territory of the Republic of Latvia of goods subject to customs duties or other valuables without the authorisation of the customs authorities, if it has been committed on a considerable scale, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to two years, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property.

(2)	For the criminal offence provided for in paragraph one of this Section, if it has been committed by a group of persons pursuant to prior agreement, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property.

(3)	For the storage, movement, forwarding or sale in the customs territory of the Republic of Latvia of goods subject to customs duties or other valuables without the authorisation of the customs authorities, if it has been committed on a large scale, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to six years, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property, and with probation supervision or without it, with deprivation of the right to engage in specific or all types of commercial activity or in a specific occupation or the right to hold a specific position for a term of up to five years.
(In the wording of the Law of 28.04.2005. with amendments made by the Laws of 13.12.2012., 29.10.2015., 03.09.2020. and 17.12.2020., which comes into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 192. Section

Manufacture, distribution, transportation, forwarding, acquisition and storage of counterfeit money and state financial instruments

(1)	For the transportation, forwarding, acquisition or storage with the intention to distribute of counterfeit banknotes, coins, state financial instruments or foreign currency in circulation or intended for circulation in the Republic of Latvia, or for the manufacture thereof, as well as for the distribution of such counterfeits —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property.

(2)	For the manufacture of counterfeit banknotes, coins, state financial instruments or foreign currency in circulation or intended for circulation in the Republic of Latvia, or for the distribution of such counterfeits, if it has been committed on a considerable scale, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to eight years, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property.

(3)	For the acts provided for in paragraph one of this Section, if they have been committed on a large scale or if they have been committed by an organised group, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term from two to ten years, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property, and with probation supervision for a term of up to three years or without it.
(With amendments made by the Laws of 10.04.2003., 18.12.2003., 05.05.2005., 13.12.2007., 08.07.2011., 13.12.2012.,
28.01.2016. and 17.12.2020., which comes into force on 01.01.2022.)

192.	1 Section. Manufacture, acquisition, storage and distribution of equipment, software, data and other means adapted for counterfeiting money

For the manufacture, acquisition, storage or distribution of such equipment, software, data, security (anti-counterfeiting) elements or any other means that are adapted for counterfeiting banknotes, coins, state financial instruments or foreign currency in circulation or intended for circulation in the Republic of Latvia, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

### 198. Section. Unlawful Acceptance of Benefits

(1)	For the unlawful acceptance of material values, benefits of a proprietary or other nature, or an offer thereof, committed personally or through an intermediary by an employee of an enterprise (company) or organisation or a person authorised on the basis of law or a legal transaction to conduct the affairs of another person, for the performance or non-performance of any action using their powers, regardless of whether the accepted material values, benefits of a proprietary or other nature are intended for that person or any other person, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to two years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the acts provided for in the first paragraph of this Section, if they have been committed on a large scale or have been committed by a group of persons pursuant to prior agreement, or material values, a benefit of a proprietary or other nature has been demanded,—

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property.

(3)	For the unlawful acceptance of material values, benefits of a proprietary or other nature, or an offer thereof, committed personally or through an intermediary by a responsible employee of an enterprise (company) or organisation or a person authorised by the enterprise (company) or organisation with the same status, or a person authorised on the basis of law or a legal transaction to resolve disputes or to adopt binding decisions, but who is not a State official, for the performance or non-performance of any action using their powers, regardless of whether the accepted material values, benefits of a proprietary or other nature are intended for that person or any other person, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to four years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property and with deprivation of the right to hold a specific position for a term of up to three years.

(4)	For the acts provided for in the third paragraph of this Section, if they have been committed on a large scale or have been committed by a group of persons pursuant to prior agreement, or material values, a benefit of a proprietary or other nature has been demanded, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property and with deprivation of the right to hold a specific position for a term of two to five years.
(16.02.2006. likuma redakcijā ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 19.11.2009., 13.12.2012., 06.06.2019. un 17.12.2020. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 01.01.2022.)

### 199. Section. Commercial Bribery

(1)	For the offering or giving of material values, benefits of a proprietary or other nature personally or through an intermediary to an employee of an enterprise (company) or organisation or to a person authorised on the basis of law or a legal transaction to conduct the affairs of another person, to a responsible employee of an enterprise (company) or organisation or to a person authorised by the enterprise (company) or organisation with the same status, or to a person authorised on the basis of law or a legal transaction to resolve disputes, so that they, using their powers, perform or do not perform any action, regardless of whether the material values, benefits of a proprietary or other nature are intended for that person or any other person, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the same acts, if they have been committed on a large scale, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine and with deprivation of the right to hold a specific position for a term of up to three years.
(Ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 25.04.2002., 12.02.2004., 19.11.2009., 13.12.2012., 06.06.2019. un 17.12.2020.
likumu, kas stājas spēkā 01.01.2022.)

199. 1 Section. Release of the Giver of Benefits from Criminal Liability

A person who has unlawfully offered or given material values, a benefit of a proprietary or other nature may be released from criminal liability if, after the commission of the criminal acts, they voluntarily report what has occurred and actively facilitate the detection and investigation of the criminal offence.
(19.11.2009. likuma redakcijā ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 13.12.2012. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 01.04.2013.)

### 200. Section

Disclosure of Non-Disclosable Information That Is Not Confidential, Secret or Top Secret Information, Unlawful Acquisition and Disclosure of Information Containing Trade Secrets and Unlawful Disclosure of Financial Market Inside Information

(1)	For the disclosure of non-disclosable information that is not confidential, secret or top secret information, if it has been committed by a person who is not a State official and who is responsible for the safekeeping of the information in accordance with law, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to one year or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the unlawful acquisition of a trade secret for one's own or another person's use or disclosure or for the unlawful disclosure of a trade secret to another person for the same purpose, as well as for the unlawful disclosure of financial market inside information —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to two years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by community service, or by a fine.

(3)	For the theft of the information referred to in the first or second paragraph of this Section —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by community service, or by a fine.
(26.05.2005. likuma redakcijā ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 13.12.2012., 28.01.2016., 06.06.2019., 17.12.2020. un 20.04.2023. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 01.05.2023.)

### 201. Section. Usury

For various types of loans that have been made knowingly exploiting the borrower's serious financial situation and the terms of which are excessively onerous for them (usury), —

shall be punished by short-term deprivation of liberty or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(Ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 12.02.2004., 13.12.2012. un 17.12.2020. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 01.01.2022.)

### 202. Section. Failure to Ensure the Quality of Goods and Services

For the deliberate manufacture and sale of goods or the provision of a service to a consumer that does not meet

the quality requirements established in regulatory enactments, normative technical documents or contracts, as a result of which substantial harm has been caused, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to two years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by community service, or by a fine.
(Ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 12.02.2004., 13.12.2007., 13.12.2012., 17.12.2020. un 07.04.2022. likumu, kas
stājas spēkā 04.05.2022.)

### 203. Section. Failure to Observe Safety Requirements for Goods and Services

For failure to observe the safety requirements for goods or services established in regulatory enactments, normative technical documents, contracts or regulations approved by duly authorised State institutions, as a result of which substantial harm has been caused, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to two years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by community service, or by a fine.
(Ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 12.02.2004., 13.12.2007., 13.12.2012., 17.12.2020.  un 07.04.2022. likumu, kas
stājas spēkā 04.05.2022.)

### 205. Section. Violation of Trading Regulations

### 206. Section

Unlawful Use of Trademarks, Other Distinctive Signs and Design Samples

(1)	For unlawful use of a trademark, other distinctive sign of goods or services or a design sample, counterfeiting of a sign or deliberate use or distribution of a counterfeit sign, if it has been committed on a considerable scale or if it has caused substantial harm, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to two years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the criminal offence provided for in paragraph one of this Section, if it has been committed by a group of persons pursuant to prior agreement, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to four years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by community service, or by a fine.

(3)	For unlawful use of a trademark, other distinctive sign of goods or services or a design sample, counterfeiting of a sign or deliberate use or distribution of a counterfeit sign, if it has been committed on a large scale, or for the criminal offence provided for in paragraph one of this Section, if it has been committed by an organised group, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to six years, with deprivation of the right to engage in specific or all types of commercial activity or in specific employment or the right to hold a specific position for a term of up to five years, and with probation supervision for a term of up to three years or without it.
(As worded by the law of 21.10.2010. with amendments made by the laws of 08.07.2011., 13.12.2012., 29.10.2015., 08.06.2017.,
17.12.2020. and 07.04.2022., which enters into force on 04.05.2022.)

(1)	(Deleted by the law of 13.12.2012.)

(2)	For entrepreneurial activity without registration or without a special permit (licence), if the necessity thereof is prescribed by law, or for continuation of the activity of an enterprise (commercial company) after an order to suspend its activity, if such entrepreneurial activity or continuation of activity has been committed on a considerable scale or if it has caused substantial harm, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by community service, or by a fine, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property and with deprivation of the right to engage in specific or all types of commercial activity or in specific employment or the right to hold a specific position for a term from two to five years.
(With amendments made by the laws of 12.02.2004., 13.12.2012., 29.10.2015., 17.12.2020. and 07.04.2022., which
enters into force on 04.05.2022.)

### 208. Section. Prohibited Entrepreneurial Activity

For engaging in entrepreneurial activity in respect of which there is a special prohibition, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by community service, or by a fine, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property and with deprivation of the right to engage in specific or all types of commercial activity or in specific employment or the right to hold a specific position for a term from two to five years.
(With amendments made by the laws of 12.02.2004., 13.12.2012. and 17.12.2020., which enters into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 209. Section. Fictitious Entrepreneurial Activity

(Deleted by the law of 21.05.2009., which enters into force on 01.07.2009.)

### 210. Section. Dishonest Receipt and Use of Credit and Other Loans

(1)	For providing deliberately false information for the receipt of subsidies, grants, credit or other loans or during the use of subsidies, grants, credit or other loans, if it has caused substantial harm, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to one year or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the same acts, if they have been committed with the intent to receive or use subsidies, grants, credit or other loans on a large scale, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to four years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by community service, or by a fine.

### 211. Section. Unfair Competition, Misleading Advertising and Unfair Commercial Practice

For unfair competition, misleading advertising or unfair commercial practice, if it has caused substantial harm, — shall be punished by short-term deprivation of liberty or by community service, or by a fine.
(As worded by the law of 13.12.2012. with amendments made by the laws of 17.12.2020. and 07.04.2022., which enters into force on 04.05.2022.)

### 212. Section

Failure to Comply with Requirements of the State Institution for Competition Protection and Promotion

For failure to comply with lawful requirements of the state institution for competition protection and promotion, if it has caused substantial harm, —

shall be punished by short-term deprivation of liberty or by community service, or by a fine.
(As worded by the law of 13.12.2012. with amendments made by the laws of 17.12.2020. and 07.04.2022., which enters into force on 04.05.2022.)

212. 1 Section. Manipulation of Sports Competitions

(1)	For manipulation of sports competitions organised by a sports organisation —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to one year or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the acts provided for in paragraph one of this Section, if they are related to the acceptance, transfer or offering of material values, benefits of a proprietary or other nature, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(3)	For the criminal offence provided for in paragraph two of this Section, if it has been committed on a large scale or if it has been committed by an organised group, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(As worded by the law of 28.01.2016. with amendments made by the law of 17.12.2020., which enters into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 213. Section. Bringing to Insolvency

(1)	For bringing a legal person subject to insolvency proceedings to insolvency through negligence, if it has caused substantial harm to the interests of another person protected by law, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to one year or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with deprivation of the right to engage in specific or all types of commercial activity or in specific employment or the right to hold a specific position for a term of up to three years.

(2)	For intentional bringing of a legal person subject to insolvency proceedings to insolvency, if it has caused substantial harm to the interests of another person protected by law, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with deprivation of the right to engage in specific or all types of commercial activity or in specific employment or the right to hold a specific position for a term from two to five years.
(As worded by the law of 13.12.2007. with amendments made by the laws of 13.12.2012. and 17.12.2020., which enters into force on 01.01.2022.)

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to two years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(3)	For obstructing the course of insolvency proceedings, which in the conduct of the debtor's (legal person's insolvency subject's) representative or natural person (in natural person's insolvency proceedings) is manifested as providing knowingly false information to the court or administrator, unlawful carrying out of transactions, concealment of property or transactions, concealment, destruction or falsification of documents, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with deprivation of the right to engage in specific or all types of commercial activity or in a specific occupation or the right to hold a specific position for a period from two to five years.

(1)	For the use of legal protection proceedings with the intent to evade the performance of obligations — shall be punished by probation supervision or by community service or by a fine.

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to two years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with deprivation of the right to engage in specific or all types of commercial activity or in a specific occupation or the right to hold a specific position for a period from two to five years.

shall be punished by short-term deprivation of liberty or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(As worded by the law of 13.12.2012 with amendments made by the laws of 17.12.2020 and 07.04.2022, which enters into force on 04.05.2022.)

(1)	For the concealment or falsification of accounting documents, annual reports, statistical reports or statistical information prescribed by law for an enterprise (commercial company), institution or organisation —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to one year or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the same acts, if they have caused substantial harm, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to four years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by community service, or by a fine.

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by community service, or by a fine.

service, or by a fine and with deprivation of the right to engage in specific or all types of commercial activity or in a specific occupation or the right to hold a specific position for a period of up to three years.

### 221. pants

Illegal Manufacturing (Production), Storage, Transportation and Sale of Alcoholic Beverages and Tobacco Products

(1)	For illegal manufacturing (production), storage, transportation or sale of alcoholic beverages or tobacco products, if committed on a considerable scale, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to two years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the criminal offence provided for in paragraph one of this Section, if committed by a group of persons pursuant to prior agreement, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property.

(3)	For illegal manufacturing (production), storage, transportation or sale of alcoholic beverages or tobacco products, if committed on a large scale, or for the criminal offence provided for in paragraph one of this Section, if committed by an organised group, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property.

(2)	For the acts provided for in paragraph one of this Section, if committed on a considerable scale or if committed by a group of persons pursuant to prior agreement, —

(3)	For the acts provided for in paragraph one of this Section, if they have caused serious consequences or if committed on a large scale, or if committed by an organised group, —

### 225. Section. Mass Disorder

For organising mass disorder involving destruction, damage, arson, destruction of property or violence against a person, or resistance to representatives of authority, or for active participation therein, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of three to twelve years and with probation supervision for a term of up to three years.
(In the wording of the law of 21.10.2010 with amendments made by the law of 08.07.2011, which enters into force on 01.10.2011. See transitional provision 11)

225. 1 Section. Violation of Restrictions and Prohibitions Established During a State of Emergency and State of Exception

(1) For violation of restrictions or prohibitions established during a state of emergency, if it has caused substantial harm, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2) For violation of restrictions or prohibitions established during a state of exception, if it has caused substantial harm, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(3) For the acts provided for in the first or second part of this Section, if they have caused serious consequences, — shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to eight years.
(In the wording of the law of 26.04.2018 with amendments made by the laws of 17.12.2020 and 07.04.2022, which enters into force on 04.05.2022.)

### 226. Section. Violation of the Procedure for Organising and Conducting Public Events

(1) For violation of the procedure for organising or conducting public events, committed by the organiser of the event or another person, if it has caused substantial harm, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to one year or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2) For the same acts, if they have caused serious consequences, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(3) For the acts provided for in the first part of this Section, if they have resulted in the death of two or more persons, — shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to eight years.
(In the wording of the law of 16.12.2004 with amendments made by the laws of 13.12.2012, 25.09.2014, 17.12.2020 and 07.04.2022, which enters into force on 04.05.2022.)

### 227. Section

Endangering Public Safety, Order and Personal Health by Performing Religious Activities

For organising or leading a group whose activities, manifested as the preaching of religious teachings and the performance of religious rituals, are associated with causing harm to public safety and order, personal health, legally protected personal interests, or for a person's participation in such activities —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to two years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(With amendments made by the laws of 12.02.2004, 13.12.2012 and 17.12.2020, which enters into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 228. Section. Desecration of a Grave and Corpse

(1) For desecration of a grave, burial urn, buried or unburied corpse —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to one year or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2) For the same acts, if they have been committed by a group of persons pursuant to prior agreement, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(3) For the acts provided for in the first or second part of this Section, if they are associated with the theft of a monument, burial urn or other objects located on a grave or in a grave, or at a burial urn, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property.
(With amendments made by the laws of 12.02.2004, 13.12.2012 and 17.12.2020, which enters into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 229. Section. Unlawful Activities with Cultural Objects

(1) For unlawful possession, movement, transmission, alienation of a cultural object, that is, a cultural monument under the protection of the Republic of Latvia or another state, a museum collection object or a specially protected library collection document, or for its unlawful export from the Republic of Latvia or import into the Republic of Latvia, if it has caused substantial harm, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to two years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2) For destruction, damage or desecration of a cultural object —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(In the wording of the law of 07.01.2021 with amendments made by the law of 17.12.2020, which enters into force on 01.01.2022.)

229.1 Section. Unlawful Activities with Antiquities

(1) For unlawful acquisition, possession, movement, transmission, alienation of an antiquity under the protection of the Republic of Latvia, which is not located in a museum collection, or an antiquity under the protection of another state, or for its unlawful export from the Republic of Latvia or import into the Republic of Latvia —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to one year or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2) For destruction or damage of an antiquity under the protection of the Republic of Latvia, which is not located in a museum collection, or an antiquity under the protection of another state —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to two years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(In the wording of the law of 07.01.2021 with amendments made by the law of 17.12.2020, which enters into force on 01.01.2022.)

229. 2 Section. Release of a Person from Criminal Liability for Unlawful Acquisition, Possession, Movement and Transmission of Antiquities

A person who has voluntarily surrendered an unlawfully acquired, possessed, moved or transmitted antiquity under the protection of the Republic of Latvia, which is not located in a museum collection, or an antiquity under the protection of another state, shall be released from criminal liability for unlawful acquisition, possession, movement or transmission of an antiquity under the protection of the Republic of Latvia, which is not located in a museum collection, or an antiquity under the protection of another state.
(In the wording of the law of 07.01.2021, which enters into force on 02.02.2021.)

### 230. Section. Cruel Treatment of an Animal and Torture of an Animal

(1)	For cruel treatment of an animal, as a result of which it has perished or been mutilated, or for torture of an animal —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with deprivation of the right to keep animals of a specific or all species for a term of up to three years.

(2)	For the same acts, if they have been committed in a public place or in the presence of a minor or if they have been committed by a group of persons pursuant to prior agreement, or if substantial harm has been caused thereby, or for torture of an animal, as a result of which it has perished or been mutilated, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with deprivation of the right to keep animals of a specific or all species for a term of up to five years.

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to two years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

### 253. pants

Unlawful manufacture, acquisition, possession, transportation and forwarding of narcotic and psychotropic substances

(1)	For unlawful manufacture, acquisition, possession, transportation or forwarding of narcotic or psychotropic substances without the intention to distribute them —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the same acts, if they have been committed by a group of persons pursuant to prior agreement or if they have been committed with narcotic or psychotropic substances in large quantities, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term from three to ten years, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property, and with probation supervision for a term of up to three years.

253.1 pants. Unlawful manufacture, acquisition, possession, transportation and forwarding of narcotic and psychotropic substances for the purpose of distribution and unlawful distribution

(1)	For unlawful manufacture, acquisition, possession, transportation or forwarding of narcotic or psychotropic substances for the purpose of distribution or for unlawful distribution of narcotic or psychotropic substances —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term from two to eight years, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property, and with probation supervision for a term of up to three years.

(2)	For the same acts, if they have been committed by a group of persons pursuant to prior agreement, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term from three to ten years, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property, and with probation supervision for a term of up to three years.

(3)	For the same acts, if they have been committed by an organised group or if they have been committed with narcotic or psychotropic substances in large quantities, or if they have caused serious consequences, as well as for distribution of narcotic or psychotropic substances to a minor, in educational institutions or on their premises, in restaurants, cafés, bars, at public entertainment or festive events —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term from five to fifteen years, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property, and with probation supervision for a term of up to three years.
(In the wording of the Law of 17.10.2002. with amendments made by the Laws of 08.07.2011., 13.12.2012. and 07.01.2021., which come into force on 02.02.2021.)

(1)	For unlawful acquisition or possession of narcotic or psychotropic substances in small quantities without the intention to distribute them or for unlawful use of narcotic or psychotropic substances, if committed by a person who has been warned about criminal liability for unlawful acquisition, possession and use of narcotic and psychotropic substances, —

shall be punished by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For unlawful manufacture, acquisition, possession, transportation or forwarding of narcotic or psychotropic substances in small quantities for the purpose of distribution or for unlawful distribution of narcotic or psychotropic substances in small quantities —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

### 254. pants

Release of a person from criminal liability for acquisition, possession, transportation and forwarding of narcotic and psychotropic substances

A person who has voluntarily surrendered narcotic, psychotropic, new psychoactive substances or products containing them, the circulation of which is prohibited or restricted, or has voluntarily reported their acquisition, possession, transportation or forwarding, shall be released from criminal liability for the use, acquisition, possession, transportation or forwarding of these substances.
(In the wording of the Law of 17.10.2002. with amendments made by the Law of 25.09.2014., which comes into force on 29.10.2014.)

—

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term from three to ten years, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property.

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to two years, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For unlawful sowing or cultivation of plants containing narcotic or psychotropic substances in large areas, or if committed by an organised group, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property.

### 261. Section. Concept of Vehicle

Vehicles referred to in Sections 175, 176, 260, 262-265 and 284 of this Law shall mean all types of automobiles, tractors and other self-propelled machines, trams, trolleybuses, motorcycles and other mechanical vehicles that move with their own power source, except vehicles with an internal combustion engine whose working volume is less than 50 cubic centimetres or an electric motor whose maximum power does not exceed four kilowatts and the maximum speed provided for in the design does not exceed 45 kilometres per hour.

### 285. Section. Illegal Movement of Persons Across the State Border

(1)	For illegal movement of a person across the state border, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years or by probation supervision, or by a fine.

(2)	For the same acts, if committed by a state official using their official position, or by a group of persons pursuant to prior agreement, or for illegal movement of several persons across the state border in one instance —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to six years, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property, and with probation supervision for a term of up to three years or without it.

(3)	For the same acts, if committed by an organised group or if they have caused serious consequences, or for illegal movement of a large number of persons, that is, more than five persons in one instance, across the state border —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of two to eight years, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property, and with probation supervision for a term of up to three years or without it.

(31) For the same acts, if committed during the operation of an enhanced border protection system or during a state of emergency declared due to a threat to the inviolability of the state border, regardless of the place of commission of the offence in the territory of Latvia —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of two to ten years, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property, and with probation supervision for a term of up to three years or without it.

(4)	For the same acts, if they have caused the death of two or more persons, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of three to fifteen years and with probation supervision for a term of up to three years.

285.1 Section. Provision of the Possibility to Illegally Stay in the Republic of Latvia

(1)	For knowingly providing a person with the possibility to illegally stay in the Republic of Latvia, if committed by a group of persons or by a state official using their official position, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years or by probation supervision, or by a fine.

(2)	For knowingly providing a person with the possibility to illegally stay in the Republic of Latvia, if committed with mercenary intent or if such possibility has been provided to two or more persons, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to six years, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property, and with probation supervision for a term of up to three years or without it.

(3)	For knowingly providing a person with the possibility to illegally stay in the Republic of Latvia, if committed by an organised group or if it has caused serious consequences, or for providing a large number of persons, that is, more than five persons in one instance, with the possibility to illegally stay in the Republic of Latvia —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of two to eight years, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property, and with probation supervision for a term of up to three years or without it.

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of two to eight years, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property, and with probation supervision for a term of up to three years or without it.

For raising the flag of the State of Latvia on a vessel, if there is no right to do so, —

shall be punished by short-term deprivation of liberty or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

For unauthorised use of the emblems of the Red Cross, Red Crescent or Blue White Shield, as well as the name of the Red Cross or Red Crescent —

shall be punished by short-term deprivation of liberty or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(As worded by the Law of 13.12.2012. with amendments made by the Law of 17.12.2020., which comes into force on 01.01.2022.)

Section 288.1 Violation of the Procedure for Installation and Use of Equipment Provided for in Regulatory Enactments for Broadcasting and Distribution of Radio and Television Programmes

(1)	(Deleted by the Law of 13.12.2012.)

(2)	For violation of the procedure for installation or use of radio wave emitting equipment for broadcasting or distribution of radio or television programmes, as well as cable network systems for distribution of television or sound broadcasting signals, provided for in regulatory enactments, if it has caused substantial harm, —

shall be punished by short-term deprivation of liberty or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(As worded by the Law of 31.10.2002. with amendments made by the Laws of 13.12.2012., 17.12.2020. and 07.04.2022., which comes into force on 04.05.2022.)

Section 288.2 Unlawful Financing of a Political Organisation (Party) or Association of Political Organisations (Parties)

(1)	For unlawful financing of a political organisation (party) or association of political organisations (parties) in a large amount —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to two years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the acts provided for in paragraph one of this Section, if they have been committed by a group of persons pursuant to prior agreement, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to four years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(As worded by the Law of 08.09.2011. with amendments made by the Laws of 13.12.2012. and 17.12.2020., which comes into force on 01.01.2022.)

Section 288.3 Intermediation in Unlawful Financing of a Political Organisation (Party) or Association of Political Organisations (Parties)

For intermediation in unlawful financing of a political organisation (party) or association of political organisations (parties) in a large amount —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to two years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(As worded by the Law of 08.09.2011. with amendments made by the Laws of 13.12.2012. and 17.12.2020., which comes into force on 01.01.2022.)

Section 288.4 Acceptance and Extortion of Unlawful Financing of a Political Organisation (Party) or Association of Political Organisations (Parties)

(1)	For acceptance of unlawful financing of a political organisation (party) or association of political organisations (parties) in a large amount —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the acts provided for in paragraph one of this Section, if they have been committed by a group of persons pursuant to prior agreement or if they are related to demanding financing of a political organisation (party) or association of political organisations (parties) in a large amount, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to four years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(3)	For extortion of financing of a political organisation (party) or association of political organisations (parties) —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(As worded by the Law of 08.09.2011. with amendments made by the Laws of 13.12.2012. and 17.12.2020., which comes into force on 01.01.2022.)

Section 288.5 Release from Criminal Liability of a Person Who Has Unlawfully Financed Political Organisations (Parties) or Associations of Political Organisations (Parties)

(1)	A person who has unlawfully financed a political organisation (party) or association of political organisations (parties) may be released from criminal liability if the unlawful financing of the political organisation (party) or association of political organisations (parties) is related to extortion or if this person, after the unlawful financing of the political organisation (party) or association of political organisations (parties), voluntarily reports what has occurred and actively facilitates the detection and investigation of the criminal offence.

(2)	Extortion shall be understood as demanding financing of a political organisation (party) or association of political organisations (parties), which is related to threats to harm the lawful interests of a person.

(3)	A facilitator and intermediary of unlawful financing of a political organisation (party) or association of political organisations (parties) may be released from criminal liability if he or she, after the unlawful financing of the political organisation (party) or association of political organisations (parties), voluntarily reports what has occurred and actively facilitates the detection and investigation of the criminal offence.
(As worded by the Law of 08.09.2011. with amendments made by the Law of 13.12.2012., which comes into force on 01.04.2013.)

Chapter XXIII
Criminal Offences against Jurisdiction

### 289. Section Falsification of Evidence

(1)	For deliberately creating false evidence or deliberately concealing existing evidence, if committed by a judge, prosecutor or investigator, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to one year or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the same acts, if they have been committed with mercenary intent or in cases concerning serious or particularly serious crimes, —

### 290. Section Bringing a Person to Criminal Liability Knowing That the Person Is Not Guilty

(1)	For bringing a person to criminal liability knowing that the person is not guilty, if committed by a prosecutor, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the same acts, if they have been committed with mercenary intent or if they are related to an accusation of committing a serious or particularly serious crime or to falsification of evidence, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(With amendments made by the Laws of 21.05.2009., 13.12.2012. and 17.12.2020., which comes into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 291. Section Unlawful Rendering of a Judgment or Decision

(1)	For deliberately rendering an unlawful judgment or decision, if committed by a judge, prosecutor or investigator, — shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation
supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the same acts, if they have been committed with mercenary intent or if they are related to an accusation of committing a serious or particularly serious crime or to falsification of evidence, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(With amendments made by the Laws of 21.05.2009., 13.12.2012. and 17.12.2020., which comes into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 301. Section. Coercion to Give False Testimony, Explanation, Opinion and Translation

(1)	For bribing or otherwise unlawfully influencing a witness, victim, person against whom criminal proceedings have been initiated, detained person, suspect, accused, applicant, expert or interpreter with the aim of causing them to give false testimony or to give a sworn false explanation to a court in an administrative case, or an opinion or to make a false translation, or to refuse to give testimony or an opinion or to make a translation —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the same acts, if they are connected with violence or threat of violence, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(3)	For the acts provided for in the first paragraph of this Section, if they are connected with torture, — shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to ten years.
(With amendments made by the laws of 27.05.2004., 12.02.2004., 21.05.2009., 19.11.2009., 13.12.2012. and 17.12.2020.
which come into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 302. Section. Refusal to Give Testimony, Opinion and to Perform Translation

(1)	For unjustified refusal by a witness, victim or other person warned about refusal to testify to give testimony in administrative offence proceedings in an institution, pre-trial investigation institution, prosecutor's office or court —

shall be punished by short-term deprivation of liberty or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For unjustified refusal by an expert or interpreter to perform the duties assigned to them in administrative offence proceedings in an institution, pre-trial investigation institution, prosecutor's office or court —

shall be punished by short-term deprivation of liberty or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(With amendments made by the laws of 21.05.2009., 21.10.2010., 13.12.2012., 11.06.2020. and 17.12.2020. which
come into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 303. Section. Persons Who Are Not Liable for Refusal to Give Testimony

The fiancé(e), spouse, parents, children, brothers and sisters, grandparents and grandchildren of a person subject to administrative liability, a person against whom criminal proceedings have been initiated, a detained person, a suspect, an accused, as well as a person with whom the natural person who committed an administrative offence or criminal offence lives together and with whom they have a common (undivided) household, are not liable for refusal to give testimony.
(In the wording of the law of 11.06.2020. which comes into force on 06.07.2020.)

### 304. Section. Disclosure of Information Obtained in Pre-trial Criminal Proceedings

For disclosure of information obtained in pre-trial criminal proceedings without the permission of the investigator or prosecutor before the completion of such proceedings, if committed by a person who has been warned about non-disclosure of the relevant information, —

shall be punished by short-term deprivation of liberty or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(In the wording of the law of 21.05.2009. with amendments made by the laws of 13.12.2012. and 17.12.2020. which come into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 305. Section. Violation of Special Protection Provisions for Persons

(1)	For non-observance of the procedure for special protection of persons established by law, as well as for disclosure of identity data or location of a protected person, committed by a person who, in connection with the performance of official duties or other circumstances, has had knowledge of information about a specially protected person and who has been warned about non-disclosure of such information, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to one year or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the same acts, if committed with mercenary intent, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to two years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(3)	For intentional disclosure of the organisation, methods, tactics, means of special protection measures or information about persons involved in the implementation of protection measures, committed by a protected person, if as a result of such acts the death of a person has occurred or other serious consequences have been caused, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(4)	For the acts provided for in the first or second paragraph of this Section, if as a result thereof the death of a person has occurred or other serious consequences have been caused, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to seven years.

(In the wording of the law of 05.05.2005. with amendments made by the laws of 13.12.2012. and 17.12.2020. which come into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 306. Section. Failure to Produce Evidence

For intentional failure to produce objects, documents or other materials that may have evidentiary significance in a criminal case, if they have been requested from a person who is not a detained person, a person against whom criminal proceedings have been initiated, a suspect, an accused, by a pre-trial investigation institution, prosecutor's office or court, —

shall be punished by short-term deprivation of liberty or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(With amendments made by the laws of 21.05.2009., 13.12.2012. and 17.12.2020. which come into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 307. Section. Unlawful Acts with Criminal Case Materials

For theft, intentional destruction, damage or falsification of criminal case materials —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(With amendments made by the laws of 13.12.2012. and 17.12.2020. which come into force on 01.01.2022.)

307. 1 Section. Violation of the Prohibition on Reproduction of Criminal Case Materials and Dissemination of Their Content

For violation of the prohibition to reproduce criminal case materials in any way or the prohibition to place at the disposal of third parties or otherwise disseminate non-publishable information arising from criminal case materials, if committed by a person who has been warned about criminal liability for violation of the said prohibitions, —

shall be punished by short-term deprivation of liberty or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(In the wording of the law of 11.10.2018. with amendments made by the law of 17.12.2020. which comes into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 308. Section. Unlawful Acts with Pledged, Seized and Confiscated Property

(1)	For squandering, damaging, alienating, concealing or destroying pledged, seized or confiscated property in administrative offence proceedings, as well as for exchanging it —

shall be punished by short-term deprivation of liberty or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the same acts, if committed by a person to whom such property has been entrusted, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to one year or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(With amendments made by the laws of 12.02.2004., 13.12.2012., 08.06.2017., 11.06.2020. and 17.12.2020. which
come into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 309. pants

Illegal transfer of substances and objects to and receipt from persons placed in short-term detention and imprisonment facilities

(1)	For the unauthorised transfer of correspondence, money, food products or other objects or substances to persons placed in short-term detention or imprisonment facilities, or receipt from such persons, if committed by an employee of these institutions, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to one year, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with deprivation of the right to hold a specific position for a term of up to five years.

(2)	For the transfer of narcotic, psychotropic substances, explosives, weapons or ammunition to persons placed in short-term detention or imprisonment facilities, or receipt from such persons —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to six years and by probation supervision for a term of up to three years or without it.

(3)	For the acts provided for in paragraph two of this Section, if committed by an employee of a short-term detention or imprisonment facility, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to eight years, with deprivation of the right to hold a specific position for a term of two to five years, and by probation supervision for a term of up to three years or without it.
(13.12.2012. likuma redakcijā ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 17.12.2020. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 01.01.2022.)

### 310. pants. Escape from short-term detention and imprisonment facility

(1)	For escape from a short-term detention or imprisonment facility —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to one year, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the same acts, if they are connected with violence or threat of violence against a guard or other official of a short-term detention or imprisonment facility, or if committed by a group of persons, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine and by probation supervision for a term of up to three years or without it.
(Ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 21.05.2009., 13.12.2012. un 17.12.2020. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 01.01.2022.)

### 311. pants. Attack in an imprisonment facility

For the formation of an organised group of persons who are in an imprisonment facility, or participation in such a group, in order to commit an attack or use other violence against an official of the imprisonment facility, a prisoner or any other person who is in the imprisonment facility, as well as for such an attack or violence —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to eight years and by probation supervision for a term of up to three years.
(Ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 13.12.2007., 21.05.2009., 08.07.2011. un 13.12.2012. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 01.04.2013. Sk. pārejas noteikumu 11.punktu)

### 312. pants. Evasion of enforcement of a court decision

(1)	For evasion of enforcement of a court decision imposing an obligation to perform specific acts, except for a decision on recovery of money or return of property, after application of a procedural sanction or penalty for non-enforcement of the decision —

shall be punished by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For evasion of serving a sentence of deprivation of liberty or restriction of rights —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to one year, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(06.06.2019. likuma redakcijā ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 17.12.2020. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 01.01.2022.)

### 313. pants. Concealment not promised in advance

(1)	For concealment not promised in advance of an offender, as well as instruments and means of committing a crime, traces of a crime, if the crime being concealed is serious, —

shall be punished by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the same acts, if the crime being concealed is particularly serious, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to two years, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(Ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 12.02.2004., 13.12.2012., 06.06.2019. un 17.12.2020. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 01.01.2022.)

### 314. pants. Acquisition, storage and disposal of criminally obtained property

(1)	For acquisition, storage or disposal of property, the value of which does not exceed a substantial amount, knowing that it has been obtained criminally, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to one year, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

### 315. pants. Failure to report a crime

For failure to report, if it is known that a serious or particularly serious crime is being prepared or committed, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to two years, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

### 316. pants. Concept of state official

(1)	State officials shall be considered to be representatives of state authority, as well as any person who permanently or temporarily performs state or local government service duties, including in a state or local government capital company, and who has the right to make decisions binding on other persons, or who has the right to perform supervisory, control, investigation or punishment functions or to manage the property or financial resources of a public person or its capital company.

(2)	The President of the State, members of the Saeima, the Prime Minister, members of the Cabinet of Ministers, as well as officials of state institutions elected, appointed or approved by the Saeima and the Cabinet of Ministers, heads of local governments, their deputies and executive directors shall be considered state officials holding a responsible position.

(3)	State officials shall also be considered to be officials of international organisations, international parliamentary assemblies and international courts and persons delegated by the said institutions, as well as any person who holds a legislative, executive or judicial office in a foreign state or in any of its administrative units, regardless of whether this person is appointed or elected to the office, as well as any person who performs a public function in a foreign state, including its administrative unit, state agency or state enterprise.

(4)	A foreign state for the purposes of this Section is any territory outside the Republic of Latvia.
(Ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 25.04.2002., 11.12.2003., 13.12.2012., 15.05.2014. un 10.03.2016. likumu, kas
stājas spēkā 07.04.2016.)
