### 317. Section. Exceeding Official Authority

(1)	For intentional acts committed by a public official that manifestly exceed the limits of rights and authority granted to the public official by law or an assigned task, if these acts have caused substantial harm, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the acts provided for in paragraph one of this Section, if they are connected with violence or threat of violence or if they are committed with mercenary intent, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with deprivation of the right to hold a specific position for a term of up to five years.

(3)	For the acts provided for in paragraph one of this Section, if they are connected with torture or if they have caused serious consequences, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to ten years, with deprivation of the right to hold a specific position for a term of up to five years.
(With amendments made by the laws of 12.02.2004., 19.11.2009., 13.12.2012., 06.06.2019., 06.07.2021. and 17.12.2020.
which enter into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 318. Section. Abuse of Official Position

(1)	For intentional acts committed by a public official by abusing their official position, if these acts have caused substantial harm, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the acts provided for in paragraph one of this Section, if they are committed with mercenary intent, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to four years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with deprivation of the right to hold a specific position for a term of up to five years.

(3)	For intentional acts committed by a public official by abusing their official position, if these acts have caused serious consequences, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with deprivation of the right to hold a specific position for a term of up to five years.

(4)	For intentional acts committed by a public official by abusing their official position, if these acts have caused the death of two or more persons, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to eight years, with deprivation of the right to hold a specific position for a term of up to five years.
(With amendments made by the laws of 12.02.2004., 13.12.2012., 25.09.2014., 06.06.2019., 06.07.2021. and 17.12.2020.
which enter into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 319. Section. Inaction of a Public Official

(1)	For failure by a public official to perform their duties, that is, if a public official intentionally or through negligence fails to perform an act which they are required to perform under law or an assigned task, and if substantial harm has been caused thereby, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the acts provided for in paragraph one of this Section, if they are committed with mercenary intent, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to four years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with deprivation of the right to hold a specific position for a term of up to five years.

(3)	For failure by a public official to perform their duties, if serious consequences have been caused thereby, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with deprivation of the right to hold a specific position for a term of up to five years.
(4)	For failure by a public official to perform their duties, if the death of two or more persons has occurred as a result thereof, — shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to eight years, with deprivation of the right to hold a specific position for a term of up to
five years.
(With amendments made by the laws of 12.02.2004., 13.12.2012., 25.09.2014., 29.10.2015., 06.06.2019., 06.07.2021. and
17.12.2020. which enter into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 320. Section. Bribery

(1)	For demanding, extorting or accepting a bribe, that is, material values, benefits of a proprietary or other nature, committed by a public official personally or through an intermediary for any lawful or unlawful act already performed or omission permitted, using their official position, regardless of whether the demanded, extorted, accepted or offered bribe is intended for this public official or any other person, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with deprivation of the right to engage in a specific occupation or the right to hold a specific position for a term of up to two years.

(2)	For accepting a bribe or an offer thereof or for demanding or extorting a bribe, committed by a public official personally or through an intermediary before performing or failing to perform any lawful or unlawful act, using their official position, regardless of whether the demanded, extorted, accepted or offered bribe is intended for this public official or any other person, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to eight years, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property and with deprivation of the right to engage in a specific occupation or the right to hold a specific position for a term of up to five years.

(3)	For the acts provided for in paragraph one or two of this Section, if they are committed on a large scale or if they are committed by a group of persons pursuant to prior agreement, or if the bribe is accepted following its demand, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term from two to ten years, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property and with deprivation of the right to engage in a specific occupation or the right to hold a specific position for a term of up to five years.

(4)	For the acts provided for in paragraph one or two of this Section, if they are committed by an organised group or by a public official holding a responsible position, or if the bribe is accepted following its extortion, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term from three to eleven years, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property, with deprivation of the right to engage in a specific occupation or the right to hold a specific position for a term of up to five years and with probation supervision for a term of up to three years.
(As worded by the law of 19.11.2009. with amendments made by the laws of 08.07.2011., 13.12.2012., 08.06.2017. and 17.12.2020. which enter into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 321. pants. Misappropriation of a Bribe

supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property.

(3)	For the criminal offence provided for in paragraph one or two of this Section, if committed by a group of persons pursuant to prior agreement or if committed on a large scale, —

(4)	For the criminal offence provided for in paragraph one or two of this Section, if committed by an organised group, or for the criminal offence provided for in paragraph two of this Section, if committed by a public official holding a position of responsibility, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to seven years, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property, and with probation supervision for a term of up to three years or without it.

### 323. pants. Bribe-Giving

(1)	For giving, offering or promising a bribe, that is, material values, benefits of a proprietary or other nature, following a request therefor, personally or through an intermediary, to a public official so that he or she, using his or her official position, performs or does not perform an action, regardless of whether the bribe given, offered or promised is intended for that public official or any other person, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the same acts, if committed on a large scale or if committed by a public official, or if committed by a group of persons pursuant to prior agreement, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term from two to ten years, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property, with deprivation of the right to engage in specific employment or the right to hold a specific position for a term of up to five years, and with probation supervision for a term of up to three years.

### 324. pants. Release of Bribe-Giver and Intermediary in Bribery from Criminal Liability

(1)	A person who has given a bribe may be released from criminal liability if the bribe was extorted from that person or if he or she, after giving the bribe, voluntarily reports what has occurred and actively facilitates the detection and investigation of the criminal offence. A person who has promised or offered a bribe may be released from criminal liability if he or she voluntarily reports what has occurred and actively facilitates the detection and investigation of the criminal offence.

(2)	Extortion of a bribe shall be understood as a request therefor for performing a lawful act, as well as a request associated with threats to harm the lawful interests of a person.

(2)	For the criminal offence provided for in paragraph one of this Section, if committed by a public official holding a position of responsibility, —

### 326. Section. Unlawful Participation in Property Transactions

(1)	For facilitating or participating in a property transaction, if committed by a state official out of mercenary motives or other personal interest, to whom it is prohibited by law in connection with their official position, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to one year, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the same acts, if committed by a state official who holds a responsible position, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with confiscation of property or without confiscation of property and with deprivation of the right to engage in specific employment or the right to hold a specific position for a term of up to five years.
(With amendments made by the laws of 12.02.2004., 13.12.2012. and 17.12.2020., which enter into force on 01.01.2022.)

326.1 Section. Trading in Influence

(1)	For offering or transferring material values, benefits of a proprietary or other nature personally or through an intermediary to any person, so that they, using their official, professional or social position, unlawfully influence the actions of a state official or induce any other person to unlawfully influence the actions of a state official, regardless of whether the material values, benefits of a proprietary or other nature are intended for that person or any other person, if there are no elements of the offence provided for in Section 323 of this Law, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For accepting material values, benefits of a proprietary or other nature, an offer thereof, or for demanding material values, benefits of a proprietary or other nature for oneself or any other person, so that they, using their official, professional or social position, unlawfully influence the actions of a state official or induce any other person to unlawfully influence the actions of a state official or decision-making, if there are no elements of the offence provided for in Sections 198 and
320 of this Law, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with deprivation of the right to engage in specific employment or the right to hold a specific position for a term of up to five years.
(In the wording of the law of 19.11.2009. with amendments made by the laws of 13.12.2012., 06.06.2019. and 17.12.2020., which enter into force on 01.01.2022.)

326.2 Section. Unlawful Demanding and Accepting of Benefits

(1)	For unlawful acceptance of material values, benefits of a proprietary or other nature, an offer thereof, committed by oneself or through an intermediary by an employee of a state or local government institution who is not a state official, or by such a person authorised by a state institution for performing or not performing any action, using their powers,

regardless of whether the accepted material values, benefits of a proprietary or other nature are intended for that person or any other person, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the same acts, if committed on a large scale or if committed by a group of persons pursuant to prior agreement, or if related to demanding or extorting material values, benefits of a proprietary or other nature,
—

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with deprivation of the right to engage in specific employment or the right to hold a specific position for a term of up to five years.
(In the wording of the law of 19.11.2009. with amendments made by the laws of 13.12.2012., 06.06.2019. and 17.12.2020., which enter into force on 01.01.2022.)

326.3 Section. Unlawful Giving of Benefits

(1)	For offering or transferring material values, benefits of a proprietary or other nature personally or through an intermediary to an employee of a state or local government institution who is not a state official, or to such a person authorised by a state institution, so that they perform any unlawful action using their powers, regardless of whether the material values, benefits of a proprietary or other nature are intended for that or any other person, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to one year, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the same acts, if committed on a large scale, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to two years, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(In the wording of the law of 13.12.2012. with amendments made by the laws of 06.06.2019., 11.11.2021. and 17.12.2020., which enter into force on 01.01.2022.)

326.	4 Section. Release of Benefit Giver from Criminal Liability

A person who has unlawfully given a benefit may be released from criminal liability if the benefit was demanded from or extorted from that person or if they, after committing the criminal acts, voluntarily report what has occurred and actively facilitate the detection and investigation of the criminal offence. A person who has offered a benefit may be released from criminal liability if they voluntarily report what has occurred and actively facilitate the detection and investigation of the criminal offence.
(In the wording of the law of 13.12.2012., which enters into force on 01.04.2013.)

### 327. Section. Official Forgery

(1)	For forging a document or for issuing or using a forged document, being aware that the document is forged, if committed by a state official, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to two years, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the same acts, if committed out of mercenary motives or if committed by a group of persons pursuant to prior agreement, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to four years, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine, with deprivation of the right to hold a specific position for a term of up to five years.
(In the wording of the law of 15.05.2014. with amendments made by the law of 17.12.2020., which enters into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 328. Section. False Official Report

For providing deliberately false information to an institution or state official who has the right to request such information, as well as for concealing a document or information or deliberate non-disclosure, if committed by a state official who has a duty to provide such information, and if it has caused substantial harm, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to one year, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(With amendments made by the laws of 12.02.2004., 13.12.2012. and 17.12.2020., which enter into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 329. Section. Disclosure of Non-Disclosable Information

For disclosure of such non-disclosable information that is not confidential, secret or particularly secret information, if committed by a state official who has been warned about non-disclosure of the information or who is responsible for safeguarding the information in accordance with law, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to one year, or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(In the wording of the law of 26.05.2005. with amendments made by the laws of 13.12.2012., 10.03.2016., 17.12.2020. and 20.04.2023., which enter into force on 01.05.2023.)

### 330. Section. Disclosure of non-disclosable information after leaving office

For the disclosure of such non-disclosable information that is not confidential, secret or top secret information, if a person has done so after leaving the service of a state official during the period specified in the warning about non-disclosure of information, —

XXV	Chapter
Criminal Offences in Military Service

### 331. Section. Concept of a criminal offence and its subjects in military service

Criminal offences in military service shall be recognised as the criminal offences mentioned in this law directed against the established order of performance of military service, which have been committed by military personnel and persons to whom special provisions provided for in laws apply.
(In the wording of the law of 17.10.2002., which enters into force on 20.11.2002.)

### 332. Section. Unauthorised absence

For unauthorised absence, that is, leaving a unit or place of service of the National Armed Forces, as well as failure to appear without justifiable reason at the appointed time at the place of service, if the unauthorised absence has lasted more than one day but not longer than three days and if it has been committed during a state of war or emergency, in combat conditions, during a state of emergency declared in the event of public disorder, terrorism or armed conflict, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to two years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(In the wording of the law of 14.12.2006. with amendments made by the laws of 13.12.2012. and 17.12.2020., which enters into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 333. Section. Desertion

For desertion, that is, leaving the place of service or failure to appear at the place of service with the intention of evading active service, if it has been committed during a state of war or emergency, in combat conditions, during a state of emergency declared in the event of public disorder, terrorism or armed conflict, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to four years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(In the wording of the law of 14.12.2006. with amendments made by the laws of 13.12.2012. and 17.12.2020., which enters into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 334. Section. Evasion of active service

(1)	For evasion of the performance of active service duties by inflicting bodily injury upon oneself (self-mutilation) or by simulating illness, forging documents or otherwise deceiving, as well as for refusal to perform service duties —

shall be punished by short-term deprivation of liberty or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the same offence, if it has been committed during wartime or in combat conditions, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to four years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(With amendments made by the laws of 14.12.2006., 13.12.2012. and 17.12.2020., which enters into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 335. Section. Insubordination

(1)	For insubordination, that is, for open refusal to execute a superior's order, as well as for other intentional non-execution of an order, if it has caused substantial harm, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to one year or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For insubordination, as well as for other intentional non-execution of an order, if it has been committed by a group of persons or if it has caused serious consequences, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(3)	For insubordination, as well as for other intentional non-execution of an order during wartime or in combat conditions —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(In the wording of the law of 13.12.2012. with amendments made by the law of 17.12.2020., which enters into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 336. Section. Non-execution of an order

For non-execution of a superior's order through negligence, if it has caused serious consequences, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to two years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(With amendments made by the laws of 13.12.2012. and 17.12.2020., which enters into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 337. Section. Resistance to a superior and coercion of him to violate service duties

(1)	For resistance to a superior, as well as to another person in connection with the performance of military service duties imposed on him or for coercing him to violate these duties, if it has been committed with violence or if it has caused serious consequences, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	(Deleted by the law of 13.12.2012.)
(With amendments made by the laws of 13.12.2012. and 17.12.2020., which enters into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 338. Section. Violence against a subordinate

(1)	For violence against a subordinate, if as a result physical suffering has been inflicted on him, —

shall be punished by short-term deprivation of liberty or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For intentional infliction of slight bodily injury on a subordinate —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to one year or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(3)	For intentional infliction of medium gravity bodily injury on a subordinate, as well as for other acts that have the character of torture, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(4)	For intentional infliction of serious bodily injury on a subordinate —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term from three to twelve years.
(With amendments made by the laws of 13.12.2012. and 17.12.2020., which enters into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 339. Section. Insult to the honour of a military person

(Deleted by the law of 13.12.2012., which enters into force on 01.04.2013.)

### 340. Section. Beating and torture of a military person

(1)	For intentional striking or beating, as well as for other intentional violence, which a military person has committed against a military person, if at least one of them is performing military service duties, —

shall be punished by short-term deprivation of liberty or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the same acts, if they are connected with the intentional infliction of slight bodily injury, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to one year or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(3)	For the acts provided for in paragraph one of this Section, if they are connected with the intentional infliction of medium gravity bodily injury or if they have the character of torture, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(4)	For the acts provided for in paragraph one of this Section, if they are connected with the intentional infliction of serious bodily injury,

Par tādu neizpaužamu militāru ziņu, kas nav konfidenciāla, slepena vai sevišķi slepena informācija, izpaušanu, — soda ar brīvības atņemšanu uz laiku līdz vienam gadam vai ar īslaicīgu brīvības atņemšanu, vai ar probācijas
uzraudzību, vai ar sabiedrisko darbu, vai ar naudas sodu.
(Ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 13.12.2012., 10.03.2016., 17.12.2020. un 20.04.2023. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 01.05.2023.)

### 353. pants. Kara vešanas līdzekļu nodošana un atstāšana ienaidniekam

Par uzticēto militāro spēku nodošanu ienaidniekam, kā arī par nocietinājumu, kaujas tehnikas vai citu kara vešanas līdzekļu atstāšanu ienaidniekam, kad to neattaisno kaujas apstākļi, komandieri —

soda ar brīvības atņemšanu uz laiku no trim līdz desmit gadiem.
(Ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 13.12.2012. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 01.04.2013.)

### 354. pants. Kaujas lauka patvaļīga atstāšana un atteikšanās lietot ieroci

Par kaujas lauka patvaļīgu atstāšanu kaujas laikā vai atteikšanos lietot ieroci kaujā —

soda ar brīvības atņemšanu uz laiku līdz pieciem gadiem vai ar īslaicīgu brīvības atņemšanu, vai ar probācijas uzraudzību, vai ar sabiedrisko darbu, vai ar naudas sodu.
(Ar grozījumiem, kas izdarīti ar 13.12.2012. un 17.12.2020. likumu, kas stājas spēkā 01.01.2022.)

### 341. Section. Abuse of Power and Exceeding Official Authority

(1)	For abuse of power or official position or exceeding official authority committed by a superior, if this offence is committed with mercenary intent or if substantial harm is caused, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For abuse of power or official position or exceeding official authority committed by a superior, if this offence has caused serious consequences, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to seven years.
(With amendments made by the laws of 13.12.2012 and 17.12.2020, which come into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 342. Section. Negligence in Service

(1)	For failure to perform official duties, as well as for negligent performance thereof, if as a result substantial harm is caused,
—

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For failure to perform official duties, as well as for negligent performance thereof, if it has caused serious consequences, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(With amendments made by the laws of 13.12.2012 and 17.12.2020, which come into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 343. Section. Squandering and Loss of Service Property

(1)	(Deleted by the law of 13.12.2012)

(2)	For the sale of weapons, ammunition, means of transport, military service equipment entrusted for service use, or for the loss of these items by violating the rules for their storage, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(With amendments made by the laws of 17.10.2002, 13.12.2012 and 17.12.2020, which come into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 344. Section. Intentional Destruction and Damage of Military Service Property

(1)	For intentional destruction or damage of weapons, ammunition, means of transport, military service equipment — shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation
supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the same acts, if they have caused substantial harm, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(With amendments made by the laws of 13.12.2012 and 17.12.2020, which come into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 345. Section. Destruction and Damage of Military Service Property by Negligence

For destruction or damage of weapons, ammunition, means of transport or military service equipment by negligence, if it has caused substantial harm, —

shall be punished by short-term deprivation of liberty or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(With amendments made by the laws of 13.12.2012 and 17.12.2020, which come into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 346. Section

Violation of the Rules for Storage, Use, Accounting and Transportation of Weapons, Ammunition, Explosives, Radioactive and Dangerous Substances

(1)	For violation of the rules for storage, use, accounting or transportation of weapons, ammunition, explosives, radioactive substances, as well as other dangerous substances, items or materials, if it has caused substantial harm, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to two years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the same offence, if it has caused serious consequences, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(With amendments made by the laws of 13.12.2012 and 17.12.2020, which come into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 347. Section. Violation of the Rules for Operating and Exploiting Combat Vehicles

For violation of the rules for operating or exploiting a combat vehicle, if it has caused the death of a person or other serious consequences, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to seven years.
(With amendments made by the law of 13.12.2012, which comes into force on 01.04.2013.)

### 348. Section. Violation of the Rules for Operating Vessels

For violation of the rules for operating a vessel, if it has caused the loss of the vessel or other serious consequences, — shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to ten years.
(With amendments made by the law of 13.12.2012, which comes into force on 01.04.2013.)

### 349. Section. Violation of the Rules for Flights and Their Preparation

For violation of the rules for a flight or its preparation, if it has caused a catastrophe or other serious consequences, — shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to ten years.
(With amendments made by the law of 13.12.2012, which comes into force on 01.04.2013.)

### 350. Section. Violation of the Guard (Security) Regulations

(1)	For violation of the guard (security) regulations or orders or instructions issued for the application of these regulations, committed while on guard or at posts, guarding ammunition, weapons, fuel, equipment warehouses or other facilities of significant importance, —

shall be punished by short-term deprivation of liberty or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.

(2)	For the same offence, if it has caused serious consequences, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to three years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(With amendments made by the laws of 13.12.2012 and 17.12.2020, which come into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 351. Section

Violation of the Service Facility Regulations, Instructions or Orders

(1)	(Deleted by the law of 13.12.2012)

(2)	For violation of the service facility regulations, instructions or orders, if committed by a serviceman assigned to round-the-clock duty (excluding guard duty), and if it has caused serious consequences, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(With amendments made by the laws of 17.10.2002, 13.12.2012 and 17.12.2020, which come into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 352. Section. Disclosure of Military Information

For disclosure of such non-disclosable military information that is not confidential, secret or top secret information, — shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to one year or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation
supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(With amendments made by the laws of 13.12.2012, 10.03.2016, 17.12.2020 and 20.04.2023, which come into force on 01.05.2023.)

### 353. Section. Surrender and Abandonment of Means of Warfare to the Enemy

For surrender to the enemy of entrusted military forces, as well as for abandonment to the enemy of fortifications, combat equipment or other means of warfare, when not justified by combat circumstances, commanders —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term from three to ten years.
(With amendments made by the law of 13.12.2012, which comes into force on 01.04.2013.)

### 354. Section. Unauthorised Abandonment of the Battlefield and Refusal to Use Weapons

For unauthorised abandonment of the battlefield during combat or refusal to use weapons in combat —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to five years or by short-term deprivation of liberty, or by probation supervision, or by community service, or by a fine.
(With amendments made by the laws of 13.12.2012 and 17.12.2020, which come into force on 01.01.2022.)

### 355. pants. Criminal conduct of a servicemember in captivity

(1)	For violence against other prisoners of war or cruel treatment of them, if committed by a prisoner of war who holds a senior position, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to seven years.

(2)	For deliberate action by a servicemember in captivity directed against the Republic of Latvia, the purpose of which is to support the enemy or assist the enemy, —

shall be punished by deprivation of liberty for a term of up to ten years.

### 356. pants

Unlawful Wearing and Malicious Use of the Emblems of the Red Cross, Red Crescent and Blue and White Shield

For the unlawful wearing of the emblems of the Red Cross, Red Crescent or Blue and White Shield in zones of military operations, if committed by a person who has no right to do so, as well as for the malicious use of the emblems of the Blue and White Shield or the flag or emblems of the Red Cross or Red Crescent, or the prescribed colouring of medical evacuation means in time of war —

the applicable sentence is deprivation of liberty for a short term, or probation supervision, or community service, or a fine.
(As amended by the law of 18.12.2003., with amendments made by the laws of 13.12.2012. and 17.12.2020., which enters into force on 01.01.2022.)

Transitional Provisions

1. The time and procedure for the entry into force of this Law shall be determined by a special law.

2. The Cabinet of Ministers shall, by 1 August 1998, develop and submit to the Saeima a draft law "On the Time and Procedure for the Entry into Force of the Criminal Law".

3. The Cabinet of Ministers shall, by 1 August 1998, develop and adopt regulations:

1) on access to computer programmes and information system security;

2) on the restriction of prostitution.

4. Articles 282.1 and 282.2 of this Law shall enter into force on 1 December 2003.
(As amended by the law of 17.10.2002., which enters into force on 20.11.2002.)

5. Article 195.2 of this Law shall enter into force on 1 July 2006.
(As amended by the law of 08.12.2005., which enters into force on 05.01.2006.)

6. The amendment to the fourth paragraph of Article 61 of this Law regarding the mandatory obligation to participate in probation programmes shall enter into force on 1 January 2013. With respect to persons sentenced under Articles 159, 160, 161, 162, 162.1, 164, 165 and 166 of this Law, the amendment to the fourth paragraph of Article 61 of this Law regarding the mandatory obligation to participate in probation programmes shall enter into force on 1 October 2011.
(As amended by the law of 30.10.2008., with amendments made by the laws of 16.06.2009. and 08.07.2011., which enters into force on 01.10.2011.)

(As amended by the law of 16.06.2009., which enters into force on 01.07.2009.)

(As amended by the law of 16.06.2009., which enters into force on 01.07.2009.)

9. The regulation provided for in points 1 and 2 of the transitional provisions of the law "Amendments to the Criminal Law" adopted on 21 October 2010, in the part concerning criminal proceedings pending before courts, prosecutor's offices and pre-trial investigation institutions for criminal offences qualified under Article 149, shall be applicable only with respect to those criminal proceedings in which the criminal offence is qualified under the first paragraph of Article 149 of the Criminal Law. In criminal cases pending before courts, prosecutor's offices and pre-trial investigation institutions for criminal offences committed before 31 December 2010 and qualified under the second, third and fourth paragraphs of Article 149 of the Criminal Law, the qualification of the offence shall remain unchanged and the sentence shall be applied to persons in accordance with the law that was in force until 31 December 2010.
(As amended by the law of 02.12.2010., which enters into force on 01.01.2011.)

10. The amendments to point 5 of the second paragraph of Article 36, Article 45, point 3 of the first paragraph of Article 52 and the fifth paragraph of Article 55 of this Law regarding the elimination of the additional sentence — police control — shall enter into force on 1 January 2015.
(As amended by the law of 08.07.2011., which enters into force on 01.10.2011.)

12. (As amended by the law of 17.12.2020., which enters into force on 01.01.2022.)

(As amended by the law of 16.10.2014., which enters into force on 01.02.2015.)

(As amended by the law of 15.01.2015., which enters into force on 01.02.2015.)

(As amended by the law of 22.06.2017., which enters into force on 01.08.2017.)

Persons who have committed the criminal offences provided for in Articles 88, 88.1, 88.2 or 88.3 of this Law before the date on which the amendment regarding the deletion of these articles entered into force shall be brought to criminal liability and punished in accordance with those provisions of this Law that were in force at the time of the commission of the respective offence.

The amendments to the first paragraph of Article 41, the sanction of the second paragraph of Article 139, the sanction of the first and second paragraphs of Article 139.1, the sanction of paragraph 2.1 of Article 141, the sanction of paragraph 2.1 of Article 195.2, the sanction of Article 221.6 and the sanction of the first paragraph of Article 239.1 of this Law regarding the principal sentence — community service and probation supervision — shall enter into force on 1 January 2022.
